description.value: Caffè Mira is a neighbourhood coffee shop that has operated in the Vancouver area since 2017, with locations on Burrard Street, Main Street, and New Westminster. The downtown Burrard Street location offers both indoor and outdoor seating alongside a menu of drinks, sandwiches, and pastries. The shop also offers catering and same-day delivery through major platforms.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 24m; stands (14 spaces) at 50m; stands (2 spaces) at 85m; stands (2 spaces) at 85m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 92m; stands (2 spaces) at 93m; stands (2 spaces) at 99m. Total: 29 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Burrard St location at 1225 Burrard St, Vancouver, and matches the OSM address. Vegetarian support is corroborated by OSM tag diet:vegetarian=yes. Takeout is explicitly confirmed by the website's 'Dine In or Take Away' language and listed delivery partners (DoorDash, Uber Eats, SkipTheDishes). No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name is 'Caffe Mira' (no accent); website consistently uses 'Caffè Mira' with accent on the è.
OSM opening_hours for the Burrard St location differ from hours shown on the website; OSM may be outdated.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active coffee shop on a cycling-accessible downtown street, but no bike parking, washrooms, or water refill have been confirmed — the three required criteria are all null, leaving the listing without enough substance to be useful in the WWC directory without further on-the-ground verification.
